mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declined in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.5 percentage point increase in unemployment rate over three months indicates labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE increased by >0.5pp over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate broad-based demand contraction that reduces corporate revenue growth expectations, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS declined in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production below 100 signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate profit growth prospects, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO is below 100.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in consumer price inflation above 3.0% annually signals persistent inflation that triggers central bank tightening, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0% annually.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.0% sustained for two months indicates restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and dampens economic activity, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeded 4.0% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment growth and rising unemployment indicate labor market weakness that reduces household income and consumer spending, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS declined and UNRATE rose in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth above 102 signals strong manufacturing output that expands corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO exceeds 102.
